description: This file contains the implementation of transactional grains used in Orleans testing, including various grain classes with different number of transactional states, and a base class that provides common functionality for state management and logging.

classes.name: GrainData
classes.description: Serializable data class used as the transactional state data structure.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain with maximum number of transactional states, used for testing multiple state handling.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain with a single transactional state.

classes.name: NoStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain with no transactional state, used for testing grains without state.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalGrainBaseClass
classes.description: Base class providing common logic for transactional grains, including state updates, additions, gets, and exception testing.

classes.name: AddAndThrowException
classes.description: Custom exception used for testing error conditions during transactions.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain's logger upon activation.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates all transactional states to a new value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a number to each transactional state's value.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves current values of transactional states.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Performs addition and then throws an exception to test error handling.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Sets a value and then throws an exception for testing.
